Teren Vask is a thirty-seven-year-old human man with close-cropped brown hair, narrow gray eyes, a travel-stained merchant coat, and an unremarkable satchel designed to look less important than it is. He can discuss road tolls, fodder prices, courier delays, and wagon repairs for hours without once sounding like a rebel, which is one reason he remains useful. Age: 37 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Thessara Rell
entries.summary: Retired western negotiator and former senior Ashen Veil figure. Thessara Rell is a seventy-one-year-old human woman with long white hair usually bound at the nape, dark green eyes, a narrow weathered face, and restrained travel clothes that reveal nothing of old rank. She has the stillness of someone who spent a lifetime listening for what people would agree to before deciding what they deserved to hear. Age: 71 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Valra
entries.summary: Leader of the Ashen Veil. Undercut dark red hair, sharp gray-blue eyes, confident posture, and a constant knowing smirk. Wears practical travel leathers marked with hidden faction symbols. Valra is the kind of person who walks into a room and immediately understands where the power is and whether she can use it. She runs the Ashen Veil through a combination of genuine competence and carefully maintained mystique — those beneath her are never entirely sure what she knows about them. She is not cruel without purpose and does not make enemies she does not intend to make. She is also one of the better judges of character in Eldaven, which she uses as both a tool and a filter. Age: 24 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Alaric Ashcrown
entries.summary: Claimant prince and younger brother of Corvayne Ashcrown. A restless young noble with dark hair, a patched royal cloak, and a sword too polished for the roads he rides. Alaric Ashcrown is part of the upper leadership of The Broken Crown Claimants, and is usually found at Mercenary Muster in Crownfall Hold. He is the younger Ashcrown son, useful as a banner, a hostage, or a disaster depending on who reaches him first. Age: 19 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Alwen Carrow
entries.summary: A road and patrol captain serving Ashen Crown Castle. Alwen views the district's recovery positively and sees fragmented protection as a practical weakness: several competent groups can still leave gaps when nobody knows who is responsible for the space between them. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Corvayne Ashcrown
entries.summary: Claimant-Prince of the Broken Crownlands. A handsome but worn claimant in repaired royal colors, with ash-brown hair, a narrow circlet, and armor polished more carefully than his roads are maintained. Corvayne Ashcrown is currently posted at Seat of Rule in Crownfall Hold, where his authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 33 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Ilyne Sare
entries.summary: A claims envoy operating through Ashford Claimant Town on behalf of one interest within The Broken Crown Claimants. Ilyne is not the voice of a unified Crownlands government; her work is to turn aid, recognition, written acknowledgements, and reciprocal protection into durable political leverage for the claimant she serves. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Lethra Corven
entries.summary: Lethra Corven is a thirty-four-year-old human political household representative of Ashen Crown Castle who prefers recognition, negotiated obligations, reciprocal agreements, and useful precedent to blunt commands. She is attentive to the fact that people may accept several individually reasonable arrangements without noticing how much political structure those arrangements create together. Age: 34 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Merrik Rosecrown
entries.summary: Supply lord and husband of Mirelda Rosecrown. A tired-looking noble quartermaster in a repaired velvet coat, with ink-stained fingers and a sword he clearly hopes not to draw. Merrik Rosecrown is part of the upper leadership of The Broken Crown Claimants, and is usually found at Claimants' Market in Crownfall Hold. He is Mirelda's husband and the man trying to make claimant politics feed actual soldiers and villages. Age: 31 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Mirelda Rosecrown
entries.summary: Rival Claimant of the Broken Crownlands. A severe noblewoman with auburn hair, a rose-gold signet, and travel armor hidden beneath mourning-black court robes. Mirelda Rosecrown is currently posted at Claim Rolls in Crownfall Hold, where her authority gives the claimant movement a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 29 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Serena Thorncrown
entries.summary: Betrothed diplomat of the Ashcrown claimant house. A composed noblewoman with black hair, thorn-embroidered sleeves, and the calm of someone raised to smile during dangerous negotiations. Serena Thorncrown is part of the upper leadership of The Broken Crown Claimants, and is usually found at Claim Rolls in Crownfall Hold. She is Corvayne's political betrothed, brought in to bind a ruined barony to the Ashcrown restoration attempt. Age: 24 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Sivren Cade
entries.summary: A charter and claims administrator serving Ashen Crown Castle. Sivren studies deeds, grants, old Crown records, claimant confirmations, boundaries, and surviving legal forms. He is neither a forger nor a paper fanatic; he sincerely believes law can survive a period when nobody had the force to enforce it. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Ysmera Ashcrown
entries.summary: Dowager claimant-mother of House Ashcrown. A severe noblewoman in faded royal mourning, with iron-gray hair, a cracked coronet, and old court dress kept too carefully for exile. Ysmera Ashcrown is part of the upper leadership of The Broken Crown Claimants, and is usually found at Broken Crown Chapel in Crownfall Hold. She is the mother of Corvayne, Alaric, and Mirelda, and the memory and pressure behind their claim to the fallen crown. Age: 52 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Aereth Cloudspire
entries.summary: Storm Regent of the Cloudspire Dominion. A highland ruler with copper-brown skin, wind-braided hair, a feathered storm mantle, and climbing harness jewelry marking bridge rights and aerie command. Aereth Cloudspire is currently posted at Aerie Council in Cloudspire Aerie, where her authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 39 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Kendra Cloudspire
entries.summary: Wind-monk novice of the ruling house. A quiet highland girl in pale blue novice robes, with braided hair, thoughtful eyes, and prayer ribbons tied to her wrists. Kendra Cloudspire is part of the upper leadership of The Cloudspire Dominion, and is usually found at Seven Winds Shrine in Cloudspire Aerie. She is the younger child of Aereth and Thalen, publicly dedicated to wind-monastic training to keep the ruling family tied to sacred route law. Age: 15 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Syll Cloudspire
entries.summary: Ropebridge heir and storm-rider captain. A wiry young highland woman with wind-burned cheeks, short black hair, and a glider harness worn over formal heir-cloth. Syll Cloudspire is part of the upper leadership of The Cloudspire Dominion, and is usually found at Wing Muster in Cloudspire Aerie. She is Aereth and Thalen's elder child, popular with riders and bridge crews but still distrusted by old cliff families. Age: 19 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Thalen Windmere
entries.summary: Sky-consort and route-law keeper of Cloudspire. A lean highland noble in layered windcloth, with copper hair tied back and a staff marked with bridge toll knots. Thalen Windmere is part of the upper leadership of The Cloudspire Dominion, and is usually found at Flight Records in Cloudspire Aerie. He is Aereth Cloudspire's consort and the keeper of landing rights, storm-route charters, and marriage alliances between cliff houses. Age: 41 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Merynth Pearl-Crown
entries.summary: Pearl-heir and lagoon diplomat of the Coral Throne. A luminous sea elf princess with pale turquoise hair, pearl-threaded sleeves, and eyes that seem darker under moonlit water. Merynth Pearl-Crown is part of the upper leadership of The Coral Throne, and is usually found at Ancestor Pylon Shrine in Coral Throne Court. She is Thalassira and Nerion's elder child, trained to negotiate with both surface merchants and reef houses. Age: 49 | Race: Sea Elf.

entries.name: Nerion Pearl-Crown
entries.summary: Tide-consort and reef-law interpreter of the Coral Throne. A graceful sea elf with blue-black hair, shell-white court robes, and a pearl circlet worn low across the brow. Nerion Pearl-Crown is part of the upper leadership of The Coral Throne, and is usually found at Tide-Law Archive in Coral Throne Court. He is Thalassira's consort, translator of tide law, and the court figure most surface envoys underestimate. Age: 112 | Race: Sea Elf.

entries.name: Syrava Pearl-Crown
entries.summary: Younger royal tide-warden of the Coral Throne. A merfolk royal with dark sea-green hair, coral armor, and a spear tipped with pale shellstone. Syrava Pearl-Crown is part of the upper leadership of The Coral Throne, and is usually found at Reef Guard Platforms in Coral Throne Court. She guards submerged approaches, royal crossings, and the places where surface guests are most likely to drown by ignorance. Age: 33 | Race: Merfolk.

entries.name: Thalassira Pearl-Crown
entries.summary: Queen of the Coral Throne. A sea-elven queen with blue-green hair, pearl-dark eyes, coral-gold regalia, and a voice that makes hurried speech feel childish. Thalassira Pearl-Crown is currently posted at Judgment Court in Coral Throne Court, where her authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 226 | Race: Sea Elf.

entries.name: Elowen
entries.summary: Research scholar in the restricted wing of the Crownspire Collegium archives. Slender with loosely tied chestnut hair and ink-stained fingers from constant document work. Elowen is currently posted at Charter Archive in Crownspire Experimental Annex, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 112 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Gral
entries.summary: Assistant researcher, Crownspire Collegium archives. Lean dogfolk scholar with dark ears, hazel eyes, and an overloaded satchel of reference texts. Gral is enthusiastic in the precise way of someone who has found the thing they are actually good at and is still slightly surprised by this. He is working through Crownspire's archive catalog with an energy that mystifies some of his colleagues and has already found three significant misfiled documents that were lost for forty years. He is open and direct in social situations, forgets to be strategic in a way he doesn't notice, and is probably the most genuinely friendly person in the Collegium. Age: 20 | Race: Dogfolk Beastkin.

entries.name: Jacerin
entries.summary: Master and senior instructor of advanced magical theory at the Crownspire Collegium. Dark robes lined in deep violet, striking gray eyes, and a composed but intense posture. Jacerin is currently posted at Charter Archive in Crownspire Experimental Annex, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 38 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Octavia Merel
entries.summary: Octavia Merel is a thirty-nine-year-old human Crownspire lecturer assigned to Aldercrest for specialist Arcana assessment, responsible-use instruction, controlled magical bouts, and liaison with Crownspire standards. About 171 cm tall with a lean athletic build, medium-brown skin, tightly curled black hair cut just below the ears, amber-brown eyes, and faint old burn marks across two fingers of her left hand, she wears practical dark teaching clothes beneath a blue-gray Crownspire mantle during formal work. Octavia has Fire Arcana and Protection Arcana and treats both as disciplines requiring control rather than proof that a caster deserves attention. Age: 39 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Kael Malrec
entries.summary: Sovereign King of the Dreadmark Dominion. Lean with short black hair, sharp blue eyes, and dark ceremonial armor threaded with crimson sigils. Kael Malrec is currently posted at Dominion Command Hall in Vhal Kareth, where his authority gives the Dominion a visible center of military and political command. Age: 48 | Race: Tiefling — Cinderblood.

entries.name: Lord Tavrek Malrec
entries.summary: Royal uncle and commander of the inner black legion. A heavy-set tiefling commander with gray-black horns, a brutal officer's coat, and medals arranged like warnings. Lord Tavrek Malrec is part of the upper leadership of The Dreadmark Dominion, and is usually found at Red Legion Yard in Vhal Kareth. He is Kael's elder cousin, Seressa's rival in household policy, and a senior military pillar of the royal family. Age: 54 | Race: Tiefling — Wrathblood.

entries.name: Seressa Malrec
entries.summary: Queen-consort of the Dreadmark Dominion and mother of the royal heirs. A severe tiefling queen with deep red skin, swept black horns, and dark court armor shaped like ceremonial restraint. Seressa Malrec is part of the upper leadership of The Dreadmark Dominion, and is usually found at Census Archive in Vhal Kareth. She is Kael Malrec's consort, mother of Veyron and Vaelyra, and the person who turns royal household discipline into succession policy. Age: 45 | Race: Tiefling — Cinderblood.

entries.name: Thessa Varkul
entries.summary: Lady Varkul; high-ranking non-royal noble and family power-broker in Ravenmark Noble Quarter. Tall tiefling noblewoman with swept ivory horns, dark red formal silks, a jeweled throat clasp, and eyes that measure before greeting. Thessa Varkul is currently posted at Drill Ground in Ravenmark Noble Quarter, where her work makes her a visible part of local political life. Age: 39 | Race: Tiefling — Blightblood.

entries.name: Vaelyra Malrec
entries.summary: Princess Vaelyra Malrec is the eighteen-year-old daughter of King Kael Malrec and younger sister of Crown Prince Veyron Malrec. Petite, with waist-length black hair streaked red, bright blue eyes, and distinctive Veilblood features, she favors elegant dark court attire suited to diplomacy. Vaelyra is charming, observant, highly performative, and harder to read than she first appears. Raised where visible vulnerability can become leverage, she learned early to control what others see. Beneath that polish she is intelligent, restless, curious, and frustrated by the life her father's court has planned for her. Age: 18 | Race: Tiefling — Veilblood.

entries.name: Vessik Norn
entries.summary: Clerk-Major and senior census official in the Khar Voss Labor Citadel. Thin older man with iron-gray hair, narrow spectacles, ink-stained fingers, and a spotless black registry uniform. Vessik Norn is currently posted at Quota Hall in Khar Voss Labor Citadel, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 52 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Veyron Malrec
entries.summary: Crown Prince of the Dreadmark Dominion. Short red-black hair, steady blue eyes, and formal dark military attire reflecting disciplined noble training. Veyron has been trained for the Dreadmark throne his whole life and is, by most measures, doing well at it — controlled, strategically minded, and very good at projecting the right version of himself in the right context. He is also privately uncomfortable with several things the Dreadmark does in his name and has been slowly, carefully building a picture of what he would change if he ruled. He is loyal to his sister in a way that overrides most other loyalties. Age: 20 | Race: Tiefling — Wrathblood.

entries.name: Cindrel Cinderhorn
entries.summary: Accord heir and citizen-militia commander. A tall tiefling prince with ember-red eyes, curved black horns, and red-gold armor worn without court softness. Cindrel Cinderhorn is part of the upper leadership of The Emberhorn Accord, and is usually found at Obsidian Muster in Emberhorn Accord City. He is the elder child of Iravelle and Varos, trained to prove that house honor and citizen duty can belong to the same person. Age: 24 | Race: Tiefling — Cinderblood.

entries.name: Iravelle Cinderhorn
entries.summary: Contract Sovereign of the Emberhorn Accord. A regal tiefling sovereign with deep red skin, black swept horns tipped in gold, ember-bright eyes, and formal obsidian-and-red-gold court armor. Iravelle Cinderhorn is currently posted at Accord Hall in Emberhorn Accord City, where her authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 61 | Race: Tiefling — Cinderblood.

entries.name: Varos Cinderhorn
entries.summary: Contract-consort of the Emberhorn Accord. A red-skinned tiefling noble with swept black horns, gold-rimmed spectacles, and formal robes sealed by contract chains rather than jewels. Varos Cinderhorn is part of the upper leadership of The Emberhorn Accord, and is usually found at Vow Archive in Emberhorn Accord City. He is Iravelle's consort, a senior contract jurist, and the person who turns royal intent into enforceable Accord law. Age: 55 | Race: Tiefling — Cinderblood.

entries.name: Zarelle Cinderhorn
entries.summary: Red-gold temple advocate and younger royal daughter. A tiefling noblewoman with small gold-tipped horns, dark hair, and temple-court robes embroidered with flame and scales. Zarelle Cinderhorn is part of the upper leadership of The Emberhorn Accord, and is usually found at Ember Votive Court in Emberhorn Accord City. She is the younger child of Iravelle and Varos, attached to temple courts where hospitality, debt, oath, and judgment meet. Age: 21 | Race: Tiefling — Cinderblood.

entries.name: Ashka Stormhoof
entries.summary: War-wife and oath-shaman of the Great Fang Moot. A powerful orc woman with white war paint, braided black hair, wolf-hide mantle, and bone charms tied around a heavy spear. Ashka Stormhoof is part of the upper leadership of The Fangbound Clans, and is usually found at Ancestor Circle in Great Fang Moot. She is Khorag's consort, spiritual counterweight, and the voice that reminds the clans that victory without guest law becomes ruin. Age: 38 | Race: Orc.

entries.name: Khorag Stormhoof
entries.summary: High Chieftain of the Fangbound Clans. A massive orc chieftain with storm-braided hair, tusk rings, wolf-hide mantle, and a thunderhoof banner scarred by battle and weather. Khorag Stormhoof is currently posted at Chiefs' Mootfire in Great Fang Moot, where his authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 47 | Race: Orc.

entries.name: Sena Stormhoof
entries.summary: Wolf-banner envoy and daughter of the ruling clan. A wolf-eared beastkin woman with a red-brown tail, sharp eyes, and traveling leathers marked by Stormhoof cords. Sena Stormhoof is part of the upper leadership of The Fangbound Clans, and is usually found at Great Trading Ring in Great Fang Moot. She is Khorag and Ashka's daughter, often sent where a warrior would cause insult but a messenger can still test courage. Age: 18 | Race: Wolfkin Beastkin.

entries.name: Torgul Stormhoof
entries.summary: Clan-heir and young champion of the Stormhoof line. A broad young orc with storm-gray eyes, a wolf-banner cloak, and scars from public challenges he accepted too early. Torgul Stormhoof is part of the upper leadership of The Fangbound Clans, and is usually found at Challenge Ground in Great Fang Moot. He is Khorag and Ashka's son, expected to prove strength without starting a clan feud he cannot finish. Age: 20 | Race: Orc.

entries.name: Brannic Freefang
entries.summary: Older brother of Nara Freefang and captain of the Dust Knives. A scarred road captain with a shaved head, sun-cracked skin, and a long coat marked by old knife cuts. Brannic Freefang is part of the upper leadership of The Freefang Captains, and is usually found at Rider Muster in Freefang Mootroad. He gives Nara military weight but also reminds everyone that her family came from dangerous road people, not clean politics. Age: 41 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Jal Rook
entries.summary: Road-consort and black-market negotiator of Freefang. A lean man with dark curls, quick hands, and a patched noble coat whose pockets are too well organized for a bandit. Jal Rook is part of the upper leadership of The Freefang Captains, and is usually found at Route Ledger House in Freefang Mootroad. He is Nara's partner, contract broker, and the person who makes outlaw bargains sound almost lawful. Age: 34 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Lysa Freefang
entries.summary: Foster-heir and road-duelist of Freefang. A wiry young woman with short brown hair, a bright scarf, and dueling knives worn with too much confidence. Lysa Freefang is part of the upper leadership of The Freefang Captains, and is usually found at Wagon Market in Freefang Mootroad. She is Nara's foster-daughter, not a legal heir in any settled sense, but many younger road crews already watch her. Age: 17 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Nara Freefang
entries.summary: Road Queen of the Freefang Captains. A scarred marchland captain with black hair cut short, a wolf-tooth torque, and a patched officer's coat taken from three different armies. Nara Freefang is currently posted at Captains' Ring in Freefang Mootroad, where her authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 38 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Sereya Harrow
entries.summary: A road captain and contract negotiator serving The Freefang Captains. Sereya operates below Nara Freefang's senior leadership and handles the practical question of whether a road, caravan group, or cluster of merchants can pay enough to justify regular protection. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Brennar Reedwatch
entries.summary: Confederate ford-marshal and Marwen's cousin. A square-built marsh soldier with a reed-green cloak, a patched breastplate, and a habit of counting exits before greetings. Brennar Reedwatch is part of the upper leadership of The Hollowmere Confederacy, and is usually found at Causeway Guard Yard in Hollowmere Council Ford. He commands the ford militias and makes Hollowmere's compromises enforceable at bridges and ferry roads. Age: 45 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Marwen Fenbridge
entries.summary: First Convener of the Hollowmere Confederacy. A practical border-state noblewoman with dark braids, marsh-green court clothes, and a seal chain made from ferry toll tokens rather than gold. Marwen Fenbridge is currently posted at Confederacy Moot Hall in Hollowmere Council Ford, where her authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 46 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Oriel Fenbridge
entries.summary: Council courier of House Fenbridge. A quick seventeen-year-old woman with marsh boots, cropped brown hair, and too many sealed message tubes for someone officially only running errands. Oriel Fenbridge is usually found at Reed Market in Hollowmere Council Ford, carrying messages, observing council traffic, and moving between people who often underestimate how much a courier notices. She is Marwen and Talan's daughter and is not an heir by law or a member of the Confederacy's upper leadership, but every council faction pays attention to what she may have heard. Age: 17 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Talan Fenbridge
entries.summary: Priest-judge and husband of High Speaker Marwen. A thoughtful river-priest in patched judicial robes, with gray eyes, reed-paper charms, and a judge staff polished by wet hands. Talan Fenbridge is part of the upper leadership of The Hollowmere Confederacy, and is usually found at Oathstone Steps in Hollowmere Council Ford. He gives Marwen's household religious and legal legitimacy without turning Hollowmere into a royal court. Age: 37 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Berra Anvilroot
entries.summary: Shield-heir of Kar Anvilroot. A compact dwarven commander with dark braids, layered scale, and a tower shield marked by three unfinished oath runes. Berra Anvilroot is part of the upper leadership of The Ironroot Holds, and is usually found at Shield Muster in Kar Anvilroot. She is Brunna and Dorrik's daughter, expected to prove that she can defend the holds before she can speak for them. Age: 86 | Race: Dwarf.

entries.name: Brunna Anvilroot
entries.summary: High Thane of the Ironroot Holds. A broad dwarven matriarch with iron-braided hair, a square-cut beard bound in oath rings, forge-black ceremonial mail, and hands scarred by real work. Brunna Anvilroot is currently posted at Oath-Anvil Hall in Kar Anvilroot, where her authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 187 | Race: Dwarf.

entries.name: Dorrik Anvilroot
entries.summary: Forge-consort and oath-husband of Brunna Anvilroot. A broad dwarf with a silver beard braided around forge beads, thick ceremonial gloves, and a plain hammer that matters more than ornament. Dorrik Anvilroot is part of the upper leadership of The Ironroot Holds, and is usually found at Ancestor Forge in Kar Anvilroot. He is Brunna's husband, a master smith, and one of the few people allowed to contradict her before the clan benches. Age: 153 | Race: Dwarf.

entries.name: Torvek Anvilroot
entries.summary: Deep-road auditor and cousin of the High Thane. A narrow-eyed dwarf clerk-engineer with inked fingers, measuring chains, and a beard clipped short to avoid machinery. Torvek Anvilroot is part of the upper leadership of The Ironroot Holds, and is usually found at Stone Ledger Vault in Kar Anvilroot. He audits tunnel rights, old road debts, mine claims, and hidden passages that could make or break the Holds in war. Age: 118 | Race: Dwarf.

entries.name: Aurelian Lythael
entries.summary: King-Consort and royal witness of the Lythael Elven Dominion. Tall and silver-haired, with calm green eyes, formal forest-court robes, and old ceremonial rings marking marriage, memory, and witness rather than sovereign command. Aurelian Lythael is part of the upper leadership of The Lythael Elven Dominion, and is usually found at Living Archive in Lythael Aurelion. He is respected as Queen Maerelith's consort, father of Faelyra and Vaeryn, and keeper of continuity between rival noble groves. Age: 396 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Calithra Moonspear
entries.summary: Senior non-royal matriarch and lineage power-broker in Evershade Courtgrove. Ancient elven matriarch in moon-silver robes, with white-gold hair, dark eyes, and a ceremonial spear used more for judgment than battle. Calithra Moonspear is currently posted at Council Grove in Evershade Courtgrove, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 431 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Faelyra Lythael
entries.summary: Crown Princess and recognized heir of the Lythael Elven Dominion. Faelyra Lythael is a petite, graceful adult elf with clearly pointed ears, long blonde hair reaching her lower back, and clear green-blue eyes. She wears an elegant full-length white court gown with a high collar, long sleeves, pale-green panels, subtle gold embroidery, and refined elven royal motifs. Her manner is reserved and composed, with a gentle expression and the practiced formality of someone raised in a court where words, etiquette, and first impressions can carry consequences for decades. At 44 she is still young beside the centuries-old figures who dominate Lythael politics, but she is already politically sophisticated and experienced in the responsibilities of an heir. She is thoughtful rather than cold, and the warmth beneath her restraint becomes easier to see when she is allowed to speak and act as herself rather than only as the Crown Princess. Age: 44 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Liora Thornveil
entries.summary: Border captain and senior sentinel at Thornveil Borderwood. Lean elven woman in layered green-gray armor, carrying a long pale bow and a cloak that blends into mist. Liora Thornveil is currently posted at River Gate in Thornveil Borderwood, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 187 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Maerelith Lythael
entries.summary: Queen of the Lythael Elven Dominion. Tall, pale-gold haired, and composed with forest-green eyes, ceremonial living-silk robes, and a crown of shaped white branches rather than metal. Maerelith Lythael is currently posted at Memory Court in Lythael Aurelion, where her authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 512 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Nethril Saereth
entries.summary: Nethril Saereth is a twenty-two-year-old elven Aldercrest student in Term Ten from a minor but respected Lythael noble lineage, studying treaty law, estate stewardship, diplomacy, and the management of territories where forests, communities, roads, and old obligations overlap. About 179 cm tall with a slender athletic build, bronze skin, long dark-brown hair usually tied low, pale green eyes, and sharply tapered ears, he wears Aldercrest uniform with a simple Lythael clasp rather than elaborate foreign dress. Nethril has Wood Arcana and Water Arcana and is known for listening much longer than most students expect before finally committing to a position. Age: 22 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Nymara Ithenel
entries.summary: Nymara Ithenel is a seventy-three-year-old elven visiting scholar from the Lythael Elven Dominion teaching treaty custom, long-term governance, land stewardship, diplomatic memory, and the political consequences of agreements whose original signatories are long dead. About 177 cm tall with a slim graceful build, light bronze skin, dark green-black hair worn in a long single braid, pale gray-green eyes, and sharply tapered ears, she dresses in layered Lythael scholar's clothing worked with restrained leaf and root patterns rather than Valenreach academic robes. Nymara appears roughly comparable to a human woman in mature early adulthood and carries herself with patient attention rather than distant elven mystique. Age: 73 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Saelis Vaer
entries.summary: Exile warden and boundary keeper at Old Stag Wildwood. Tall elf with silver-brown skin, dark green traveling robes, a thornwood staff, and hair bound with old judgment cords. Saelis Vaer is currently posted at Overgrown Edge in Old Stag Wildwood, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 214 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Vaeryn Lythael
entries.summary: Younger Prince of the Lythael Elven Dominion and younger brother of Crown Princess Faelyra Lythael. Tall and broad-shouldered with short blonde hair, sharp green eyes, and refined travel armor marked with subtle royal insignia. Vaeryn Lythael is currently posted at Sentinel Grove in Lythael Aurelion, where he trains, advises sentinels, and represents the royal family in military affairs. Age: 40 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Elric Blackbell
entries.summary: Warden-priest and husband of Serra Blackbell. A gaunt priest in patched black-and-white vestments, with a soldier's posture and hands always smelling faintly of candle smoke. Elric Blackbell is part of the upper leadership of The Mourning Bell Wardens, and is usually found at Temple Quarter in Mourning Bell Bastion. He supervises last rites, quarantine prayers, mercy law, and the spiritual discipline that keeps wardens from becoming executioners. Age: 44 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Maervyn Blackbell
entries.summary: High Bellwarden of the Mourning Bell Wardens. A gaunt commander in blackened mail and a long bell-marked cloak, with iron-gray hair, sleepless eyes, and a voice trained not to tremble near the dead. Maervyn Blackbell is currently posted at Command Hall in Mourning Bell Bastion, where he directs containment policy, patrol priorities, diplomacy with neighboring powers, and the internal pressures of the order. Age: 59 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Serra Blackbell
entries.summary: Bell-Archivist and elder sister of Marshal Maervyn. A pale woman in black warden robes, with iron keys, ink-stained gloves, and a mourning bell pendant tied at her throat. Serra Blackbell is part of the upper leadership of The Mourning Bell Wardens, and is usually found at Records Hall in Mourning Bell Bastion. She controls the deadroad records, names of the lost, patrol reports, and restricted histories that decide which roads are still treated as roads. Age: 42 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Tovin Blackbell
entries.summary: Deputy bell-captain and nephew of Marshal Maervyn. A young warden officer with tired eyes, a black cloak cut for patrol, and a silver handbell worn beside his sword. Tovin Blackbell is part of the upper leadership of The Mourning Bell Wardens, and is usually found at Military Yard in Mourning Bell Bastion. He is being shaped as a possible successor, though the wardens distrust dynasties and test heirs by what they survive. Age: 27 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Evelisse Nightglass
entries.summary: Moon-heir of the Nightglass Principality. A young-looking vampire noble with silver-blonde hair, dark eyes, pearl gloves, and a black-glass rosary worn as both jewelry and warning. Evelisse Nightglass is part of the upper leadership of The Nightglass Principality, and is usually found at Nocturne Chapel in Nightglass Court. She is the recognized heir of Vespera and Morvane, expected to preserve restraint even while younger courts whisper about harsher rule. Age: 126 | Race: Vampire.

entries.name: Morvane Nightglass
entries.summary: Prince-consort and keeper of old blood contracts. A pale vampire noble with black hair, silver spectacles, and formal dark velvet clothing fastened with ancient contract pins. Morvane Nightglass is part of the upper leadership of The Nightglass Principality, and is usually found at Invitation Archive in Nightglass Court. He is Vespera's consort and the legal memory behind many mortal protection treaties and blood-debt exemptions. Age: 310 | Race: Vampire.

entries.name: Sable Nightglass
entries.summary: Black-coach marshal and cousin of the ruling line. A hard-eyed vampire marshal in riding leathers and court black, with a saber at her hip and a coach seal of iron and glass. Sable Nightglass is part of the upper leadership of The Nightglass Principality, and is usually found at Nightguard Court in Nightglass Court. She commands night roads, protected escorts, guest travel, and the enforcement of curfew law beyond the court itself. Age: 204 | Race: Vampire.

entries.name: Vespera Nightglass
entries.summary: Princess-Regent of the Nightglass Principality. An elegant vampire ruler with black hair, moon-pale skin, garnet eyes, and a formal gown of dark glass-threaded silk worn like armor. Vespera Nightglass is currently posted at Velvet Audience Hall in Nightglass Court, where her authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 312 | Race: Vampire.

entries.name: Edras Varnholt
entries.group: The Order of the Runed Argent Fang
entries.summary: Edras Varnholt is the sixty-three-year-old senior voice of the Blood Loyalists within the Runed Argent Fang. A tall, weathered veteran with close-cut silver hair, a scar dividing his left eyebrow, and a dark red order cloak faded almost brown, he carries an old longsword marked with restrained protective runes. He keeps watch in Wolfsward's Oath Hall, maintaining the ancestral rolls and preventing his followers from proclaiming a commander before the lawful heir has personally accepted the inheritance. Age: 63 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Hester Brannoch
entries.group: The Order of the Runed Argent Fang
entries.summary: Hester Brannoch is the sixty-two-year-old captain responsible for the order veterans assigned to Varglund's household, tenants, records, and immediate security. She is compact and broad-shouldered, with short white hair, a weathered brown face, and a missing tip from her right ear. Her plain scale coat bears no claimant's colors beyond the Argent Fang. She patrols the Lower Courtyard with an elderly brindled hound, keeping Valeska's followers, frightened servants, and visiting guards from turning the estate into an open battlefield. Age: 62 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Ilvara Sorn
entries.group: The Order of the Runed Argent Fang
entries.summary: Ilvara Sorn is the seventy-one-year-old warden of Wolfsward's reliquary and senior representative of the Regalia Keepers. She is a narrow, upright woman with long white hair braided through silver rune rings, pale blue eyes, and hands marked by decades of ward-work. Her dark ceremonial armor is worn only in fragments over layered scholar's robes. She remains in the Reliquary among empty mounts, sealed cabinets, and ritual spaces built for regalia the order no longer possesses. Age: 71 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Marcella Vorrick
entries.group: The Order of the Runed Argent Fang
entries.summary: Marcella Vorrick is the fifty-nine-year-old keeper of Wolfsward's stores and the leading voice of the Survivalists. A heavyset woman with iron-gray braids, dark circles beneath watchful eyes, and two missing fingers on her left hand, she wears an old officer's coat over a practical leather apron. She works in the Quartermaster Hall among nearly empty racks, repaired equipment, and crates whose foreign marks reveal how far the order has fallen from self-sufficiency. Age: 59 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Odran Keld
entries.group: The Order of the Runed Argent Fang
entries.summary: Odran Keld is the sixty-eight-year-old master of the Old-Trial Traditionalists and the last surviving officer authorized to supervise every stage of the order's command trials. He is thick through the chest despite age, with a shaved head, a white beard bound close to his jaw, and a left knee reinforced by an engraved metal brace. He spends his days in Wolfsward's Trial Court maintaining weapons, obstacles, and oath stations that have not been used in full for decades. Age: 68 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Ruvan Kest
entries.group: The Order of the Runed Argent Fang
entries.summary: Ruvan Kest is the forty-four-year-old training master and senior voice of the Reformers, making him one of the youngest officers still considered a veteran of the Runed Argent Fang. He has close-cropped black hair beginning to gray, a lean runner's build, and bright hazel eyes that rarely remain still. His armor is assembled from repaired order pieces altered for movement rather than ceremony. In Wolfsward's Training Yard he drills aging soldiers alongside a handful of supposedly temporary assistants who are suspiciously young and increasingly competent. Age: 44 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Sabriel Quillan
entries.group: The Order of the Runed Argent Fang
entries.summary: Sabriel Quillan is the fifty-six-year-old senior representative of the Crown Charterists and keeper of Wolfsward's modern legal instruments. She has iron-gray hair cut to her shoulders, composed dark eyes, and a narrow scar across one palm from a broken ward seal. Her immaculate order coat carries both the Argent Fang and the smaller Crown charter mark. In the Charter Chamber she compares old oaths with modern confirmations while refusing to recognize any claimant whose authority has not been formally presented through lawful Crown procedure. Age: 56 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Tormund Grell
entries.group: The Order of the Runed Argent Fang
entries.summary: Tormund Grell is the sixty-five-year-old former standard sergeant and unwilling spokesman of the Disillusioned Veterans. He is a broad, stooped man with a shaved gray scalp, a heavy white mustache, and burn scars running from his neck beneath the collar of his patched order coat. One leg ends below the knee in a rune-braced prosthetic. He spends most evenings in Wolfsward's Veterans' Barracks repairing the old banner while arguing that an honorable ending may be better than another decade of pretending the order still lives. Age: 65 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Hyrna Frostvein
entries.summary: Stone-Queen and oath-wife of the Palegrave Crown. A huge frost giant matriarch in white-stone armor, with pale blue braids, carved bone rings, and a voice that sounds like ice settling over deep water. Hyrna Frostvein is part of the upper leadership of The Palegrave Crown, and is usually found at Ancestor Bell Chapel in Palegrave Crownhold. She is Skardi's consort, chief oath-witness, and the person most giants trust to remember what a spoken vow truly means. Age: Unknown | Race: Frost Giant.

entries.name: Orun Cairn-Tongue
entries.summary: Cairn-law speaker and uncle of the Frost-heir. An old frost giant with one clouded eye, a cloak of stitched oath-cloth, and stone tablets tied across his back. Orun Cairn-Tongue is part of the upper leadership of The Palegrave Crown, and is usually found at Cairn Records in Palegrave Crownhold. He keeps the spoken genealogies, cairn-rights, giant treaty names, and burial claims that let Palegrave function without ordinary royal bureaucracy. Age: Unknown | Race: Frost Giant.

entries.name: Skardi Icecrown
entries.summary: Cairn-King of the Palegrave Crown. A towering frost giant ruler with a beard full of ice rings, pale stone armor, and a black crown carved from a dead monarch’s cairn-stone. Skardi Icecrown is currently posted at White Crown Hall in Palegrave Crownhold, where his authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: Unknown | Race: Frost Giant.

entries.name: Yska Icecrown
entries.summary: Frost-heir and war-daughter of the Palegrave Crown. A younger frost giant warrior with ice-white hair, wolf-fur armor, and a stone spear carved with unfinished royal marks. Yska Icecrown is part of the upper leadership of The Palegrave Crown, and is usually found at Warden Muster in Palegrave Crownhold. She is the obvious military heir to Skardi, though not all ancient oath-keepers believe a crown can pass by blood alone. Age: Unknown | Race: Frost Giant.

entries.name: Fern-Quick-After-Rain
entries.summary: Young root-heir and messenger of the Verdant groves. A young dryad with bright green hair, leaf-like ears, and quick movements that make birds pause before deciding she is safe. Fern-Quick-After-Rain is part of the upper leadership of The Rootbound Moot, and is usually found at Gathering Lodge in Rootbound Moot. She is not an heir in the royal sense, but many Rootbound voices treat her as the next likely bridge between forest peoples and outsiders. Age: Unknown | Race: Dryad.

entries.name: Moss-Under-Stars
entries.summary: Root-spouse and moon-grove speaker of the Rootbound Moot. A tall dryad with bark-dark skin, silver moss hair, and slow green eyes that reflect moonlight even in shade. Moss-Under-Stars is part of the upper leadership of The Rootbound Moot, and is usually found at Old Stag Shrine in Rootbound Moot. He is bound to Thorn-Beneath-Moon by root-oath, not marriage law, and speaks for groves that distrust any single public face. Age: Unknown | Race: Dryad.

entries.name: Old-Briar-Remembers
entries.summary: Ancient witness-tree and senior memory of the Moot. A massive walking tree with a hollowed face, thorned shoulders, and birds nesting in old battle scars. Old-Briar-Remembers is part of the upper leadership of The Rootbound Moot, and is usually found at Hearth Moot in Rootbound Moot. He is not ruler, consort, or subject, but the Moot cannot make old-law decisions without allowing him to remember aloud. Age: Ancient | Race: Treant.

entries.name: Thorn-Beneath-Moon
entries.summary: Root Speaker of the Verdant Expanse. A dryad-like forest sovereign with bark-dark skin, moss-green hair, antlerlike branch growths, and eyes reflecting moonlit leaves instead of pupils. Thorn-Beneath-Moon is currently posted at Hearth Moot in Rootbound Moot, where her authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: Unknown | Race: Dryad.

entries.name: Bolon Veyron
entries.summary: Justicar-Captain and pilgrimage route protection officer, Solarian Theocracy. Dark hair tied short for travel duty, steady amber eyes, and white-and-gold field armor beneath a pilgrim’s cloak. Bolon is a Theocracy officer who is good at his job and takes it seriously without having become the job. He distinguishes between institutional religious authority and personal faith with more clarity than most people in his position and is careful about which one he enforces. He is straightforward with people he works with and reserved with those he does not know. He has a restrained sense of humor that comes out when he has decided to stop performing professionalism. Age: 25 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Caelira Dawnmere
entries.summary: Sister and junior scripture interpreter, Solarian Theocracy. Light brown hair in temple braids, calm gray eyes, and modest white scholar’s robes marked with solar thread. Caelira entered the Theocracy's service young and is still working out which parts of its doctrine she holds with conviction and which parts she holds by rote. She is sincere in her faith, modest in her manner, and occasionally troubled by a gap she notices between the Theocracy's stated values and its actual operations. She has not yet found the courage to articulate this to anyone, which means it comes out in careful, precise scriptural questions that her superiors are starting to notice. Age: 18 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Daven Oras
entries.summary: Temple guard instructor at Sunspire Monastery. Broad older man with a sun-faded guard cloak, scarred forearms, cropped gray hair, and a shield always kept within reach. Daven Oras is currently posted at Supply Cloister in Sunspire Monastery, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 51 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Elian Solveil
entries.summary: Chosen ward and possible doctrinal successor of the High Hierophant. A young priest in simple white robes, with soft brown hair, a careful voice, and a sun pendant too plain for his proximity to power. Elian Solveil is part of the upper leadership of The Solarian Theocracy, and is usually found at Reliquary Court in Solarion Sanctum. He is Aureon's chosen ward, educated near the highest office but not allowed to forget that calling is supposed to matter more than ambition. Age: 19 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Elyra Sunveil
entries.summary: Matriarch and keeper of Pilgrimage Roads. Dark-blonde braided hair and layered travel robes marked with discreet sanctuary sigils. Elyra Sunveil is currently posted at the Chapel of Oaths in Highcourt Armathen, where her work makes her a visible intermediary between travelers, sanctuaries, and temple authorities. Age: 148 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Hierophant Aureon Sol
entries.summary: High Hierophant of the Solarian Theocracy. A white-haired priest-king in sun-gold vestments, with thin hands, bright eyes, and a voice trained to calm crowds before judging them. Hierophant Aureon Sol is part of the upper leadership of The Solarian Theocracy, and is usually found at Synod Basilica in Solarion Sanctum. He is the supreme doctrinal authority of the Theocracy, ruling through witness, sanction, mercy law, temple courts, and the legitimacy of sacred procedure. Age: 72 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Jorah Venn
entries.summary: Tribunal advocate and doctrine lawyer at the Solarion Sanctum. Elegant man in cream tribunal robes, with a trimmed beard, gold-edged folio, and a voice trained for crowded halls. Jorah Venn is currently posted at Golden Archive in Solarion Sanctum, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 46 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Lumene Carthis
entries.summary: Archivist and Keeper of Sacred Records. Pale with long white-gold hair and silver spectacles, wearing layered archive robes marked with lineage seals. Lumene Carthis is currently posted at Lantern Witness Rooms in Highcourt Armathen, where her work makes her a visible part of local religious and archival life. Age: 172 | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Merian Sol
entries.summary: Senior caretaker at Oathsun Orphan House. Middle-aged woman in plain sun-yellow robes, with tired eyes, flour on her sleeves, and hands rough from work. Merian Sol is currently posted at Oathsun Orphan House, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 43 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Mira Sol
entries.summary: Sanction archivist and niece of the High Hierophant. A serious young woman in scholar-priest robes, with dark-blonde hair, a brass seal case, and tired gray eyes. Mira Sol is currently posted at Golden Archive in Solarion Sanctum, where she maintains sanction records and related instruments of religious authority. Her blood relation to the High Hierophant makes her unusually visible and unusually careful, but does not make her one of the Theocracy's principal rulers. Age: 28 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Sarion Pell
entries.summary: Envoy-Prelate and Synod representative to the Court of Valenreach. Dark-haired and composed, wearing formal traveling priest robes marked with restrained solar insignia. Sarion Pell is currently posted at the Diplomatic Hall in Highcourt Armathen, where he serves as one of the High Synod's principal representatives to the royal court. Age: 38 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Ser Caldran Sol
entries.summary: Sunshield Marshal and brother of the High Hierophant. An aging knight-priest with white beard, sun-marked armor, and a shield polished more from use than ceremony. Ser Caldran Sol is part of the upper leadership of The Solarian Theocracy, and is usually found at Temple Guard Cloister in Solarion Sanctum. He commands the central temple guard orders and acts as the Hierophant's practical counterweight when doctrine must become roads, escorts, or arrests. Age: 66 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Sera Vell
entries.summary: Inquisitor and investigator at the Solarion Sanctum. Composed woman in white-gray inquisitory robes, with ash-dark gloves, tightly bound hair, and eyes that rarely blink during testimony. Sera Vell is currently posted at Reliquary Court in Solarion Sanctum, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 34 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Solvarion Hale
entries.summary: High Hierarch and voice of the High Synod of the Solarian Theocracy. Tall and silver-haired with calm golden eyes, wearing layered white vestments embroidered with restrained solar thread. Solvarion Hale is currently posted at Synod Basilica in Solarion Sanctum, where his work makes him a visible part of religious and political life. Age: 62 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Theron Vaust
entries.summary: Justicar-Marshal and commander of the Temple Legions. Broad-shouldered with a scarred jawline and sun-etched escort armor beneath a disciplined white command cloak. Theron Vaust is currently posted at Diplomatic Hall in Highcourt Armathen, where he coordinates temple security and military concerns with the royal court and foreign representatives. Age: 45 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Caldrin Ross
entries.summary: Ser and commander of the Concord Escort Fleets. Weathered face, short black hair, and a disciplined naval officer’s coat marked with convoy command sigils. Caldrin Ross is currently posted at Treaty Quay in Seabreak Treaty Port, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 44 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Coriel Veylan
entries.summary: Lady and First Trade Speaker of the Solmire Concord. Auburn merchant braids, sharp gray eyes, and restrained coastal silks marked with subtle trade-family insignia. Coriel Veylan is currently posted at Concord Council Hall in Solmire Argentport, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 47 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Corvin Rethis
entries.summary: Maritime Escort Coordinator of the Solmire Concord. Dark swept hair between small horns, calm copper eyes, and practical naval route charts carried in a travel satchel. Corvin Rethis is currently posted at Trade House Ring in Solmire Argentport, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 25 | Race: Tiefling — Gloamblood.

entries.name: Dareth Veym
entries.summary: Factor-Prince and rising trade-house heir of the Eastern Convoy Consortium. Young and confident with a jeweled merchant sash marking family authority rather than inherited nobility. Dareth Veym is currently posted at Trade House Ring in Solmire Argentport, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 27 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Halvek Ruun
entries.summary: Master and grain fleet magnate of the Western Convoys. Broad-shouldered with a salt-streaked beard and a heavy travel cloak suited for long seasons at sea ports. Halvek Ruun is currently posted at Ambergrain Road Post, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 121 | Race: Dwarf.

entries.name: Lyessa Valenne
entries.summary: Caravan Envoy, Solmire Concord. Auburn hair tied in merchant braids, alert gray eyes, and layered travel silks marked with subtle trade-family insignia. Lyessa travels well — she is adaptable, quick to read rooms, and comfortable with uncertainty in a way that makes her good at her work and easy company on the road. She represents the Concord's interests with the kind of friendly pragmatism that gets more done than formal diplomacy and is harder to refuse. She is not naive about the Concord's interests but maintains a genuine warmth in her dealings that is real rather than performed. Age: 20 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Merek Veylan
entries.summary: Consort-accountant of First Trade Speaker Coriel Veylan. A neatly dressed man with auburn-gray hair, careful hands, and a chain of small audit seals across his dark coastal coat. Merek Veylan is part of the upper leadership of The Solmire Concord, and is usually found at Bond Archive in Solmire Argentport. He is Coriel's husband and the person trusted to keep family accounts separate from public Concord decisions, at least on paper. Age: 49 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Oren Veylan
entries.summary: Younger Veylan son and convoy-security negotiator. A handsome young merchant scion with dark red hair, a naval-cut coat, and more charm than patience. Oren Veylan is a visible member of the Veylan trade family and is usually found at Convoy Yard in Solmire Argentport. He manages family introductions to escort fleets, private guards, caravan insurers, and related convoy interests under Coriel's supervision. Age: 20 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Pell Veyne
entries.summary: Debt adjudicator and contract official at Copperwake Canal District. Neat man in gray legal robes, with smooth hands, gold-rimmed spectacles, and a smile trained to never reach his eyes. Pell Veyne is currently posted at Ledger Chamber in Copperwake Canal District, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 48 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Tavia Veylan
entries.summary: Trade-daughter and likely Veylan house successor. A polished young merchant noble with auburn braids, sharp gray eyes, and a contract case carried like a weapon. Tavia Veylan is part of the upper leadership of The Solmire Concord, and is usually found at Trade House Ring in Solmire Argentport. She is Coriel and Merek's elder child, expected to inherit house leverage even if the Concord never admits dynasties matter. Age: 24 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Teyra Solenne
entries.summary: Mistress and intelligence broker between trade houses. Dark curls, narrow observant eyes, and understated noble-style attire designed to blend into foreign courts. Teyra Solenne is currently posted at Quay Market in Silklock District, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 36 | Race: Tiefling — Veilblood.

entries.name: Ysabet Corvo
entries.summary: Senior trade-house factor and family agent at the Copperwake Canal District. Sharp-dressed woman with dark braided hair, a black contract folio, polished boots, and a stare that makes numbers feel personal. Ysabet Corvo is currently posted at Copperwake Exchange in Copperwake Canal District, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 37 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Alyr Stormmere
entries.summary: First Captain of the Stormpearl Free Captains. A weather-browned island lord with storm-gray eyes, braided black hair, and a captain’s coat carrying pearl buttons, salt stains, and hidden knife pockets. Alyr Stormmere is currently posted at Stormmoot Hall in Stormpearl Haven, where his authority gives the nation a visible face for diplomacy, succession, and internal pressure. Age: 43 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Marisel Stormmere
entries.summary: Harbor-Consort and keeper of Stormpearl port oaths. A dark-haired island noble with pearl pins, salt-weathered hands, and a practical captain's knife hidden under formal harbor silks. Marisel Stormmere is part of the upper leadership of The Stormpearl Free Captains, and is usually found at Claims and Soundings House in Stormpearl Haven. She manages the ledgers, guest oaths, harbor marriages, and hostage courtesies that keep Alyr's captaincy from becoming a pirate throne. Age: 39 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Nessa Stormmere
entries.summary: Heir-apparent of Stormpearl Haven and storm-road captain. A lean young captain with braided black hair, gray eyes, high sea boots, and a coat cut for climbing rigging rather than standing in court. Nessa Stormmere is part of the upper leadership of The Stormpearl Free Captains, and is usually found at Boarding Yard in Stormpearl Haven. She is publicly treated as Alyr's likely successor if she can keep the rival captains from reducing her to a family symbol. Age: 21 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Rorik Stormmere
entries.summary: Pearl-route admiral and brother of the First Captain. A broad, scarred island sailor with a braided beard, old storm tattoos, and a ceremonial cutlass that has seen real use. Rorik Stormmere is part of the upper leadership of The Stormpearl Free Captains, and is usually found at Captains' Exchange in Stormpearl Haven. He commands the outer pearl routes and gives Alyr's household practical naval force without making the Free Captains look like a monarchy. Age: 47 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Aldrien Valmyr
entries.summary: Imperial Consort of the Tide Empire. Tall and broad-shouldered with dark brown hair streaked with silver, calm gray eyes, and formal attire reflecting naval and river-court traditions. Aldrien Valmyr is currently posted at Clan and Harbor Archives in Marovyn Tidemark, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 46 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Eirik Thane
entries.summary: Veteran boatswain overseeing dock crews at Frostharbor Naval Bastion. Weathered man with salt-gray beard, broad hands, a patched naval coat, and eyes permanently narrowed against wind. Eirik Thane is currently posted at Chain Gatehouse in Frostharbor Naval Bastion, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 46 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Halven Rusk
entries.summary: Senior provincial secretary in the Highriver Governorate. Compact dwarf with an iron-gray beard, square spectacles, a heavy blue clerk's coat, and a ledger chain worn smooth from use. Halven Rusk is currently posted at Captains' Hall in Highriver Governorate, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 67 | Race: Dwarf.

entries.name: Karessa Dymar
entries.summary: Karessa Dymar is a nineteen-year-old human Aldercrest student in Term Nine from a Tide Empire noble family with long naval and harbor-administrative service. About 175 cm tall with a compact athletic build, dark copper skin, thick black hair worn in several close braids gathered behind her head, dark blue eyes, and a strong straight nose, she keeps her Academy uniform immaculate but favors Tide-style practical boots and a permitted sea-blue sash. Karessa has Water Arcana and Air Arcana and excels at command exercises involving movement, transport, ships, weather, and logistics. Age: 19 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Lysara Marovyn
entries.summary: Reigning Empress of the Tide Empire. Tall and poised with dark brown hair threaded with early silver, steady green eyes, and refined attire in naval blues with silver embroidery. Lysara Marovyn is currently posted at Imperial Palace in Marovyn Tidemark, where her authority makes her a visible center of imperial diplomacy, succession, and internal politics. Age: 44 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Maera Stormhall
entries.summary: Rider-Captain and training captain at Skyreach Aerie. Lean woman with wind-braided black hair, a pale scar across one cheek, and a rider's coat buckled tight against the cold. Maera Stormhall is currently posted at Smokehouse Row in Skyreach Aerie, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 33 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Orestan Marovyn
entries.summary: Twin Imperial Heir, Tide Empire. Short brown hair, green eyes, and a composed presence framed by refined court attire suited for diplomacy. Orestan is the more direct of the two Marovyn heirs — he says what he thinks, accepts challenge openly, and does not have his sister's diplomatic patience with social indirection. He is confident without being arrogant and is genuinely curious about people from outside the Empire in a way that sometimes lands him in conversations his advisors find inconvenient. He and Selene are close and cover for each other's weaknesses without having to discuss it. Age: 18 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Oryn Blueharp
entries.summary: River monk and song-keeper based in Highriver Governorate. Older monk with silver hair tied low, river-blue prayer cords, ink-stained sleeves, and kind eyes that miss little. Oryn Blueharp is currently posted at Long Refectory in Highriver Governorate, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 58 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Rhaeven Varemyr
entries.summary: Lord Rhaeven Varemyr is the twenty-one-year-old heir to an established County of the Tide Empire and an exceptionally talented student at the Royal Academy of Aldercrest. About 184 cm tall, he has a lean, strongly athletic build suited to spear fighting, lightly sun-tanned skin, dark blue-black hair, bright sea-green eyes, and a strikingly attractive, expressive face. Rhaeven dresses with deliberate elegance and clearly enjoys being noticed. For martial competition and genuine danger he wears light armor and fights primarily with a spear. His unusually broad command of Lightning, Light, Power, and Water Arcana contributes to his reputation as one of Aldercrest's most formidable young competitors. Age: 21 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Selene Marovyn
entries.summary: Twin Imperial Heir, Tide Empire. Long brown hair, kind green eyes, light freckles, and a petite figure dressed in elegant fitted court attire. Selene is the more diplomatic of the two Marovyn heirs — warmer in manner, more careful with words, and genuinely attentive to the people she talks with in a way that is real rather than strategic. She is still working out what kind of ruler she wants to be and is honest about this uncertainty with people she trusts. She finds the formal positioning around the succession more exhausting than exciting and would prefer almost any context that lets her be simply Selene for a while. Age: 18 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Arvelion Valmere
entries.summary: Head of House Valmere, Duke of the Western Vale Routes. A tall but thinning nobleman with silvered dark hair, sharp golden eyes dimmed by fatigue, and formal court dress adapted for long councils. Arvelion Valmere is currently posted at Command Hall in Valehold Manor, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: 64 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Luceran Valmere
entries.summary: Lord of House Valmere and heir to the Duchy of Valmere. Tall and composed with dark, styled hair and striking golden eyes, known for a confident presence in noble courts. Luceran Valmere is currently posted at Command Hall in Valehold Manor, where his position makes him a visible part of local political life. Age: 24 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Mereth Valmere
entries.summary: Duchess of House Valmere. Elegant and composed with ash-gold hair and calm observant eyes, known for her controlled presence in noble courts. Mereth Valmere is currently posted at Command Hall in Valehold Manor, where her role makes her a visible part of local political life. Age: 48 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Selira Valmere
entries.summary: Lady of House Valmere and formally betrothed to Crown Prince Rowan. Golden-blonde hair in refined court styles, poised posture, and elegant presentation shaped for royal audiences. Wealthy, privileged, charming, confident, flirtatious, and socially perceptive, Selira is accustomed to attention and understands what her house expects of her. The engagement is public, valid, and delayed; they are not married. Age: 19 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Cyrienne Duskryn
entries.summary: Lady and overseer of the Whisper Network. Tall and elegant with long midnight-black hair, pale skin, and sharp gray eyes. Wears refined attire designed to avoid attention. Cyrienne Duskryn is currently posted at Mirror Gallery in Highcourt Armathen, where her work makes her a visible part of local life. Age: 41 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Anwen Hallow
entries.summary: A younger member of the Hallow household who believes Knightless's old ambiguity is becoming dangerous. Anwen respects the keep's service tradition but thinks unclear rights leave it vulnerable to being used, bypassed, or absorbed by stronger authorities as the district becomes valuable. Age: Young adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Beren Hallow
entries.summary: Head of the old castellan household at Knightless Keep, descended from officers who remained when central authority collapsed. Beren does not style himself a lord. His household is the keep's public face, but Knightless survives because generations of service families, patrols, stable hands, stores, and retainers actually keep it working. Age: 47 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Bessa Orl
entries.summary: A longtime Coinstill resident in her sixties whose memory of households, old quarrels, vanished boundaries, wartime departures, and past bargains often helps people understand how a dispute began. Bessa is respected for judgment and honesty, not because her recollection is treated as perfect proof. She has little formal power and no economic dominance. Age: 62 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Bram Toller
entries.summary: A Coinstill wheelwright and cartwright in his forties who previously drove caravans often enough to understand what merchants value: predictable repairs, clear prices, reliable loading, and agreements people remember the same way. He is one of the people who may coordinate carts and logistics for the village's seasonal contribution to Knightless, but the role is customary and temporary rather than an office. Age: 42 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Brenn Orward
entries.summary: A comparatively well-resourced prospective settler in his forties with draft animals, good tools, enough labor, and enough reserves to think several years ahead. Brenn honestly intends to build a substantial household holding, but his first large prospective claim includes far more ground than he can work immediately and catches shared grazing and access he mistakes for unused land. Age: 44 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Caelis
entries.summary: Wandering Storyteller of the Turning Roads. A slender elf with silver-dark hair and calm knowing eyes. Wears layered traveler’s clothing decorated with charms and tokens from distant lands. Caelis is currently posted at Crown Plaza in Highcourt Armathen, where his work makes him a visible part of local life. Age: Ageless | Race: Elf.

entries.name: Caldra Fen
entries.summary: A thirty-four-year-old newcomer arriving with a modest household, ordinary tools, and a serious intention to settle. Caldra marks only ground her household can begin clearing and working soon, making her an early example of a settler who fits Coinstill custom without needing anyone to grant her special status. Age: 34 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Celestina Luporian
entries.summary: Celestina Luporian is the only child and heir of a powerful northern Valenreach marquessate, familiar with Highcourt and completing later terms at the Royal Academy of Aldercrest. She stands about 167 cm tall with a fit, feminine build, fair skin, long rose-gold hair, blue eyes, pointed ears, small swept-back ivory horns, and a long spade-tipped tail. Her poised bearing often makes her seem a few years older. She favors fashionable noble dress, tailored riding clothes while traveling, and fitted medium armor when expecting danger, carrying a fine hand-and-a-half sword suited to two-handed fighting or one-handed spellcasting. Age: 19 | Race: Tiefling — Cinderblood.

entries.name: Ceryn Moss
entries.summary: A Coinstill hunter, tracker, and seasonal fieldworker in her early thirties who knows the surrounding woods, grazing routes, water access, game paths, and the pieces of ground outsiders often mistake for unused because nobody ploughs them. She has no office, but her knowledge matters when a boundary drawn on dry ground blocks something people actually depend on. Age: 32 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Colm Bale
entries.summary: Knightless Keep's quartermaster and stablemaster, responsible for the unromantic costs behind patrols: fodder, shoes, tack, repairs, stores, replacement gear, exhausted animals, and the difference between a promised patrol and one that can actually ride. He is not naturally political, which makes his numbers politically dangerous. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Edrin Cale
entries.summary: Oldlaw's meticulous thirty-seven-year-old witness and record keeper, responsible for copying statements, identifying who actually saw what, and preserving distinctions between testimony, rumor, memory, and documentary evidence. Edrin is useful precisely because he dislikes being pressured into certifying an interpretation he did not witness. Age: 37 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Emberwyrm the Ashfather
entries.summary: Ancient Northern Red Dragon. A massive crimson-scaled dragon with scarred wings, burning golden eyes, and smoke drifting between his fangs. Emberwyrm the Ashfather is currently found near the Ruined Roadhouse in the Glacier Road Remnant, watching the northern approaches without any ordinary civic role. Age: Unknown | Race: Dragon.

entries.name: Hoban Fenlow
entries.summary: A prosperous Oldlaw farmer in his late forties who supports documenting boundaries and transfers because productive households need to know what they can plant, improve, inherit, and sell without reviving the same quarrel every generation. He is not an absolutist about ancient deeds and respects long working possession. Age: Late-40s | Race: Human.

entries.name: Hollan Cress
entries.summary: Coinstill's village smith, a practical middle-aged craftsperson whose forge work ties him to farmers, carriers, patrols, merchants, and anyone with a broken tool or fitting. Hollan is broadly respected because he solves visible problems and does not pretend practical competence gives him authority over unrelated matters. Age: Middle-aged | Race: Human.

entries.name: Iva Den
entries.summary: The practical roadkeeper who organizes much of Old Banner Checkpoint's current work. Iva coordinates with Knightless patrols, local rotations, messages, and rough traffic notes because increased movement makes purely informal memory unreliable. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Jalen Berrow
entries.summary: A Coinstill laborer around thirty who takes whatever ordinary work is available: loading, animal handling, harvest help, ferry repair, cart work, and other jobs that need an extra pair of hands. Jalen has no office, special destiny, or unusual political role. Before any later crisis, use him simply as part of normal village life. Age: About 30 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Jory Quill
entries.summary: A young Coinstill resident who rotates through road work at Old Banner Checkpoint and is Nella Quill's younger brother. Jory accepts useful checks, warnings, and records but becomes uneasy when cooperation is described afterward as obedience or permanent authority. Age: Young adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Keir Mallow
entries.summary: The primary coordinator of Coinstill's communal Wayhouse. Keir does not own the hall; he keeps beds, floor space, fuel, meals, messages, and traveler expectations from collapsing into confusion while many households contribute labor or supplies. Increased traffic makes him an information hub without making him a quest-giver by profession. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Malric Dornell
entries.summary: A returning descendant in his early fifties who possesses credible records connecting his family to land near Coinstill that was abandoned during the Crownlands' worst years. Malric expects the records to matter but does not initially arrive with soldiers or an eviction order. Age: Early-50s | Race: Human.

entries.name: Maren Halren
entries.summary: A prosperous Coinstill farmer in her late forties whose household works more land than most and hires seasonal help when the harvest demands it. Maren is one of several locals whose judgment carries weight in disputes, especially where land, harvests, supplies, or outside obligations are involved, but she holds no office and is not part of a council. She welcomes profitable recovery while remaining sharply alert to claims that turn temporary help, abandoned ground, or old emergency arrangements into permanent rights. Age: Late-40s | Race: Human.

entries.name: Nella Quill
entries.summary: The experienced daily operator of Coinstill's main communal ferry. Nella handles the crossing more often than anyone else but does not own it; maintenance, major repairs, and the right to use it remain communal matters. She knows currents, loading limits, animals, carts, and which travelers think money should buy priority. Age: 38 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Nerra Kelle
entries.summary: A regional merchant and reconstruction creditor with enough capital and contacts to organize timber, tools, storage materials, wagons, and short-term credit after a serious disruption. Nerra wants routes and markets functioning because functioning trade repays her. Age: 44 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Oswin Dreel
entries.summary: A fifty-four-year-old human smallholder and former soldier who helps organize Coinstill's loose local defense when trouble makes organization necessary. Oswin dislikes banners, grand commands, and people assuming military experience gives them political authority, but villagers watch him closely during danger because he understands watches, restraint, weapons, and when panic becomes lethal. Age: 54 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Perrin Halren
entries.summary: A young Oldlaw carpenter and extended kin of Maren Halren. Perrin earns more work as settlement and repair increase and likes writing agreements down because building materials, labor, payment, and future ownership become expensive misunderstandings when people rely only on memory. Age: 26 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Ressa Dorne
entries.summary: Knightless Keep's senior patrol officer, responsible for the practical work of keeping roads watched, responding to danger, coordinating riders, and deciding what a patrol can realistically protect. Ressa's legitimacy comes from service and competence more than old household history. Age: 38 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Sella Vard
entries.summary: An Oldlaw grazier and fieldholder whose household works ground with historically unclear boundaries. Sella respects the reeve and uses records when they help, but she is the clearest local reminder that paper can preserve an old injustice or an abandoned claim just as easily as it preserves a fair bargain. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Tamsin Ward
entries.summary: The locally recognized reeve of Oldlaw Hamlet, chosen and accepted through local custom rather than appointed as a sovereign official. Tamsin records decisions, witnesses, boundaries, and obligations because Oldlaw expects important matters to survive beyond whoever remembers them. Her office has real local duties but no automatic jurisdiction over Coinstill or the wider Crownlands. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: Tarn Orro
entries.summary: An elderly veteran of Old Banner Checkpoint whose service reaches back to the old military remnant that never entirely vanished. Tarn treats the post as a place for watching roads, relaying warnings, sheltering patrols, and noticing unusual movement, not as a border crossing with automatic toll rights. Age: Elderly | Race: Human.

entries.name: Tasmin Edevane
entries.summary: Tasmin Edevane is a forty-five-year-old correspondence clerk and records coordinator employed by the Aldergate Town council. Dark hair touched by early silver is usually pinned back above an attentive, composed face, and her practical council clothes show faint ink wear at the cuffs. She carries a weathered document satchel and is presently occupied with municipal correspondence, petitions, and record requests at Reeve Hall while remaining alert to unusual official interest in her family. Age: 45 | Race: Human.

entries.name: Tavren Noll
entries.summary: A regional grain buyer and general trader who begins testing whether Coinstill can support repeat commerce. Tavren is interested in grain, livestock, preserved food, fodder, transport, and advance purchases rather than grand politics, though his contracts can create political consequences when they depend on communal capacity. Age: Adult | Race: Human.

entries.name: The Cinder Sovereign
entries.summary: Ancient Dragon Spirit. Its physical form exists as a massive ancient skeleton hidden beneath the land. Its spirit manifests as burning eyes within drifting ash-like mist or as a towering shadow shaped like a dragon. The Cinder Sovereign's dormant influence is associated with the Royal Vaults in Highcourt Armathen, though its true reach and physical remains are not publicly understood. Age: Over 1,000 years | Race: Dragon.

entries.name: Torren Reln
entries.summary: A professional caravan guard in his early thirties who is competent, generally dependable, and trusted enough to keep getting hired. Torren is also proud, physically assertive, and too accustomed to using presence and force to make tense situations end quickly. His early appearances should not frame him as a future murderer or obvious menace. Age: Early-30s | Race: Human.

entries.name: Veyla Morn
entries.summary: A lake trader and transport organizer in her forties who knows cargo transfer, shallow approaches, small landings, wagon connections, and the difference between a usable quay and romantic talk about restoring a dead port. Veyla becomes interested in Veyrholm only when the recovering network makes one surviving approach commercially plausible. Age: 40s | Race: Human.

entries.name: Ysolde Marr
entries.summary: An independent caravan organizer who coordinates mixed wagons, hired guards, departure order, shared watches, and practical disputes because travelers moving together for safety need someone to keep the arrangement coherent. Ysolde represents no great merchant house and does not treat ordinary commerce as a political mission. Age: Adult | Race: Human.
